subject: Credit top-up request tied to pen-test schedule for MedNav Private POC
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@mednav.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: security@mednav.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: additional pilot credits + pen-test timeline for Private POC

Diego —

Thanks again for the Private POC demo last week. MedNav is excited about the performance on our imaging extraction workloads, but our procurement and security teams require a short on-prem/Private evaluation window (air-gapped) with a vendor-led pen-test before we can move to a paid pilot.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood provide a modest credit top-up for the isolated trial (we estimate ~$8k of GPU run time) so we can extend the PoC from 2 to 3 weeks while the pen-test runs?
2) What info do you need from our security team to scope the pen-test and get it scheduled?

I'm attaching a short pen-test scope doc and a draft MOA that our legal team prefers. If we can align on schedule this week we can start the security kickoff next Tuesday.

Appreciate the help — Carlos

Attachments: mednav_pen_test_scope_v1.pdf (PDF, 24KB), moa-draft-mednav.docx (DOCX, 18KB)
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@mednav.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: additional pilot credits + pen-test timeline for Private POC

Hi Carlos —

Thanks for the scope and the MOA. Quick read-through looks fine; we can support the isolated Private trial and the pen-test but need two things to approve a credit top-up:

- A signed MOA (covers responsibilities and data handling) or a thumbs-up from your legal contact to proceed with the current draft.
- A definitive pen-test window (start/end dates) and the vendor conducting the test so our infra team can schedule an isolated maintenance window.

Operationally, we can apply a one-time eval credit of up to $10,000 to your account tied to the PO number or MOA signature. The credit will be conditional: it will be released once the pen-test kickoff is confirmed and evidence (email confirmation from the pen-test vendor) is provided. This is standard for security-gated subsidies.

Aditya — tagging you for commercial approval of the conditional credit and any billing/process notes.

Laura — can you share the procurement flow for how MedNav should surface the PO/MOA so we can apply the credit cleanly on our side?

Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@mednav.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional pilot credits + pen-test timeline for Private POC

Diego / Carlos —

I'm good to approve a $10k conditional top-up (commercial) tied to the security gating language Diego outlined. Please note the credit will be timebound: valid for 30 days from issuance; if MedNav doesn't complete the pen-test kickoff within that window, we can reassess.

Next steps for MedNav:
- Sign the MOA or confirm legal approval via email to diego@redwood.ai
- Confirm pen-test vendor and proposed kickoff week (we require 48 hours notice prior to any isolated maintenance window)
- Share a PO number or internal reference for invoicing (Laura will help map billing)

Laura — please confirm the internal billing flow and whether we should route the credit as an account-level promo or as an invoice line item.

Thanks — Aditya
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@mednav.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional pilot credits + pen-test timeline for Private POC

Hi Carlos —

Thanks — quick admin note to close the loop: we can apply the $10,000 conditional credit as an account promo (no upfront invoice). To proceed please:

1) Reply to this thread with one-line legal approval ("MedNav legal approves MOA v1 and we authorize Redwood to proceed") or attach the signed MOA.
2) Confirm pen-test vendor and kickoff week (we'll reserve the maintenance window once that's confirmed).
3) Provide a PO number or internal cost center code for our records — we won't invoice against it unless the credit is exceeded.

Once we receive items 1–3, I'll create the promo credit and send a confirmation that it's active. If you need the credit sooner for scheduling reasons, flag that in your reply and we'll expedite — but we'll still need the same evidence within 48 hours of credit issuance.

Looking forward to getting MedNav started.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Finance
Redwood Inference
